description: This file defines the entity models for a preventive maintenance management system, including User, Asset, MaintenanceTask, Schedule, and TaskHistory classes, with properties, data annotations, and relationships.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity with properties for ID, Name, Email, Role, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: Asset
classes.description: Represents an asset with identifying details, location, description, creation date, and collections of associated maintenance tasks and schedules.

classes.name: MaintenanceTask
classes.description: Represents a maintenance task with details, related asset, assigned user, status, priority, due date, creation date, and task history.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Represents a schedule for maintenance, including frequency, next run date, last run, notes, creation date, and related asset.

classes.name: TaskHistory
classes.description: Tracks actions performed on maintenance tasks, including action type, details, performer, and creation date.
